title: product.category.updated
description: Triggered when a product's categories are updated. Generated from https://docs.salla.dev/webhook-events/products (fetched 2026-10-26).

merchant.description: Unique identifier associated with the Merchant who installed the application on their store. Get details on the Merchant via the ID  using the endpoint [here](https://docs.salla.dev/9466620e0)

id.description: Unique identifier associated with a product. Get a list of products IDs [here](https://docs.salla.dev/5394168e0)

categories.description: List of categories assigned to the product

id.description: Unique identifier associated with the category. Get a list of category IDs [here](https://docs.salla.dev/5394207e0)
